learning_outcomes.text: Can recognize typical characteristics of different manufacturing systems
Learns models and approaches used in manufacturing systems such as mass production, flexible manufacturing systems, cellular manufacturing.
Can apply performance analysis approaches in manufacturing systems
Can use quality control tools used in manufacturing systems.
